name: Give
label: Revelation
lede: A D.C. hardcore band named by a singer on deployment in Iraq, built around flowers, clay art and 7"s on half the labels in the country, that finally landed on the label whose early records had rewired his head.

eras.title: A G-word from Iraq
eras.text: Singer John Scharbach, known as Crucial John, came up with the band while stationed in Iraq. It existed loosely from 2005 and became a real band at the tail end of 2008, playing its first show on a Rival Schools bill.

years.h: John Scharbach names Give while stationed in Iraq
years.p: Scharbach was listening to the band Gone a lot and liked its look, so he hunted for another short word starting with G. Give starts loosely that year.

years.h: Give's first show: opening for Rival Schools at the Ottobar
years.p: Give officially start playing and recording in November 2008, and their first show is at Baltimore's Ottobar, opening for [[Rival Schools|c661021c-3a9f-49d2-948a-c7f357cb1c87]].

eras.title: Flowerheads
eras.text: Give put out a half dozen 7"s on labels from React to Triple B, toured Central America and Europe, and called their fans flowerheads. Members doubled in Rival Mob, No Tolerance and Mob Mentality, and the band ran its own label, Moonflower.

years.h: Give's 7"s: Heaven Is Waiting to I Am Love
years.p: Heaven Is Waiting (React), Boots of Faith (Deranged), Flowerhead (Youngblood), Petal Pushing (Painkiller) and I Am Love (Triple B), plus a self-titled 12" on Give's own Moonflower Records.

years.h: Give tour Central America with Lion of Judah
years.p: Give play Central America with Lion of Judah, and US runs with [[Bane|adf5ac61-4d7b-4cbc-95ce-ee2dc486f884]], Code Orange Kids, [[Night Birds|c7a4d766-6bc7-4766-b86e-35e8d8e3fa43]] and Tenement.

years.h: The Electric Flower Circus, Give's first full-length
years.p: Thirteen songs on Give's own Moonflower Records. Vice's Tony Rettman premiered it the day before and called Give one of the best bands in the American underground.

years.h: Give tour Europe from Cologne to Wunstorf
years.p: Give spend most of November 2014 on a European tour that starts in Cologne and ends in Wunstorf, Germany.

eras.title: Clay flowers on Revelation
eras.text: For John Scharbach, a Revelation record meant something: the label's early catalog was where his idea of music came from. Give's Revelation 12" was recorded by Don Zientara and wrapped in clay art from Japan.

q: Revelation's early catalog changed the way I thought about music.
years.src: Discogs · Revelation Records pressing history · Punknews · DxR interview
years.p: Four songs, recorded by Don Zientara, with clay artwork by Japanese artist Kinya Masuo. The 330 black copies were sold only on Give's January 2015 West Coast tour.
years.xp:
The songs are Sonic Bloom, Learning to Die, Brand New Flag and Eat the Rainbow. Revelation pressed 1,087 on gold (clear yellow, per Discogs) and 328 on red alongside the tour-only black.

Punknews called Give post-flowerchild punks, too trippy for easy comparisons.
